data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"An append-only event log requires neither idempotent nor merely safe writers; it requires what is best called 'effectively idempotent' writers\u2014writers that attach deterministic identity to each event so that the composite operation of 'ensure-this-event-is-in-the-log' is idempotent even though the primitive 'append-bytes' is not. The published distinction between idempotent and safe maps to the difference between the primitive and the composite operation, and the log needs the composite to be idempotent.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If the log is purely byte-level with no semantic layer (no event keys), then 'effective idempotency' cannot be achieved and the system relies solely on safety.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the published literature defines idempotency strictly at the primitive operation level (not composite), then 'effective idempotency' is not idempotency at all.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the replay engine does not enforce key uniqueness, the composite operation is not idempotent and the system fails.","eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"Consider the operation not as 'append bytes B' but as 'append event E with key K.' The first is non-idempotent. The second, viewed through the lens of the log's semantic state (which events are represented), is idempotent: appending E with key K twice leaves the same set of represented events {E}. The writer must be safe at the byte level (retries don't corrupt the log) and effectively idempotent at the semantic level (retries don't add new information). The published 'safe' property corresponds to the byte-level requirement; the published 'idempotent' property corresponds to the semantic-level requirement\u2014and the log needs both, with the semantic-level idempotency being the decisive one for deterministic replay.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
